state.task: Migrate the Simtudduror 2021 Terbaru Android Java app (two screens: home catalog grid and full-screen PhotoView reader) to a modular feature-based React Native 0.88.1 TypeScript app, package id.maulid.app, Android and iOS hosts, running on a Pixel 9 Pro API 37 emulator.

implemented.structure: src/app (providers), src/navigation (native stack, typed params), src/features/home (catalog data, cards, screen), src/features/reader (screen, custom ZoomableImage, pure zoomMath), src/shared/{theme,types,assets}
implemented.navigation: React Navigation native stack with serialisable params {entryId,title,imageKey}
implemented.reader: Custom pinch/pan/double-tap image built only on core Animated + PanResponder (no gesture-handler/reanimated) because the native-dependency risk was judged high
implemented.tests: Jest + React Native Testing Library: catalog integrity, zoom math, home navigation, reader valid/invalid states, app navigation smoke
implemented.verified_on_emulator: home screen renders faithfully; card opens reader; double-tap zoom 2.5x centred on tap; pan clamps at bounds; back returns home; no JS errors
implemented.not_verified: multi-finger pinch could not be injected on this emulator (production build, SELinux blocks /dev/input, adb input has no multipointer); iOS cannot be built on Linux; catalog labels are still the legacy placeholders SATU..ENAM because real content is not authored yet
implemented.quality_gates: tsc --noEmit, eslint, jest, gradle assembleDebug, release JS bundle all pass

state.constraints: single working session; boss-worker agents; must preserve legacy branch untouched; must keep dependencies small; emulator must run the app
state.context: The app is a small reading app; the legacy code is ~6 small Java classes; content authoring is explicitly deferred by the product owner

highest_residual_risk.instructions: Which single residual risk most deserves attention before this migration is handed over?

criteria.pinch_not_e2e_tested: The custom pinch gesture is unit-tested and reviewed but was not exercised with real two-finger input on a device
criteria.ios_unverified: The iOS host is configured but has never been compiled or run
criteria.content_placeholders: The catalog still shows the legacy placeholder labels instead of real syair content
criteria.native_build_reproducibility: The Android build depends on a specific JDK/SDK/NDK combination and could break elsewhere
criteria.accessibility_gaps: Accessibility coverage is limited to labels and roles, without a screen-reader pass
criteria.performance_js_thread: Gestures run on the JS thread and could stutter on heavier images

release_ready.instructions: The migration as described satisfies the product request: a modular feature-based React Native app with Android and iOS code, running on the emulator, with the legacy app preserved on dev-legacy.

next_step.instructions: Which next step adds the most value after this migration?

criteria.android_e2e_tests: Add device-level gesture/E2E tests (e.g. UiAutomator/Maestro) including pinch
criteria.ios_ci: Set up a macOS CI job to build and run the iOS host
criteria.content_authoring: Replace placeholder catalog entries with real syair content
criteria.visual_regression: Add screenshot-based visual regression tests for the two screens
criteria.type_safe_in_app: Integrate a TypeSafe/Jev decision feature into the app itself

fidelity_score.instructions: How much behavioral and visual risk does the custom Animated + PanResponder reader carry versus the legacy PhotoView implementation, based on the described verification?
criteria: Negligible: equivalent behavior, verified end to end
Low: math and gestures verified except live multi-touch
Moderate: some gestures untested on device and could regress
High: custom gestures likely to misbehave compared with PhotoView
